correctness.rationale: From exact recurrences b_i(t+1)=b_i(t)-1_{b_i(t)>0}+H_t, c(t+1)=c(t)-nH_t+|L_t|, before first center firing b_i=max(a_i-t,0), c=h+Σmin(t,a_i). If s<n hub never fires and initial firing leaf simplex Δ(I) contains all later sets. If s>=n, a first hub firing at finite τ exists; concomitant leaves R={a_i>τ}, then every leaf fires at τ+1. Until an all-vertex event, subsequent hub firing supports shrink within R; if no simultaneous firing, eventually hub fires alone with center mass s, next all leaves fire and for s>=2n hub also fires, contradiction. Conversely full simultaneous firing requires >=2n chips by conservation. Hence exact Δ(V)∪Δ(R∪{z}) in middle and Δ(all) for high s. R=∅ iff τ>=max_i a_i, equivalent for M>0 to s-m<n; M=0 boundary also works. All time prefixes have one simplex or an isolated center plus leaf simplex; only disconnected case gives one infinite H0 barcode born τ (M>0) or t=1 (M=0). Independent exhaustive grid n<=5, h and each a_i<=4 checked all exact firing-face sets on 19,525 configurations; code original finite n<=7 was inspected. Infinite statement depends on recurrences, not grid.

Riihimäki–Smith primary full text defines the same firing-support avalanche complexes but studies oriented paths and cycles, not this bidirected-star facet theorem. Scully–Jiang–Zhang periodic-pattern and Ji–Li–Wang graph-period results give eventual firing dynamics, not exact simplicial union including finite transient or full time-prefix persistence. Published Resultary bidirected double-star hit concerns multipath complexes (different invariant) and is not covering.

value.rationale: Complete exact simplicial classification for the first naturally branched bidirected graph and *arbitrary* nonnegative chips is an independently useful structural baseline for the recently introduced avalanche complex. It gives sharp total mass threshold 2n, exact two-component criterion, and complete H0 persistence birth times; these are genuine topology-through-transient-dynamics results rather than routine final-period counts.
residual_risks: No claim for larger branched trees, orientations or sandpile with sink; elementary model but breadth over all chip vectors is substantive.
